source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 11 (PDF 288-298), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Vector Valued Functions and Their Derivatives (TOC: '...and Their Differentiations')) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 A stone is thrown from the origin with initial speed \(v_{0} = 49\) m/s at \(60^{\circ}\) above the horizontal; \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), air resistance ignored. (i) Construct its position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) with its domain. (ii) Find how far from the origin it lands. (5 marks)
(Aik pathar origin se \(v_{0} = 49\) m/s par horizontal se \(60^{\circ}\) oopar phenka jata hai; \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), hawa ki rukawat nahin. (i) Domain ke saath position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) banayein. (ii) Yeh origin se kitni door girta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen qadam: horizontal component constant speed se, vertical component gravity ke saath, phir hawa mein rehne ka waqt.
steps: Domain: \(y = 0\) se \(t = 0\) ya \(t = 5\sqrt{3}\); is liye \(0 \le t \le 5\sqrt{3} \approx 8.66\) s

blocks.prompt:
2 A ball is kicked from the origin with \(v_{0} = 20\) m/s at \(45^{\circ}\) (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Construct \(\mathbf{r}(t)\), eliminate \(t\) to find the equation of its path, and use it to find where it lands and its greatest height. (5 marks)
(Ball origin se \(v_{0} = 20\) m/s aur \(45^{\circ}\) par kick hoti hai (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) banayein, \(t\) khatam kar ke raaste ki equation nikalein, phir girne ki jagah aur sab se zyada height nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Components likhein, x-component se t nikal kar y-component mein rakhein; raasta neeche ki taraf khulne wala parabola hai.
blocks.final_answer: Raasta \(y = x - 0.0245x^{2}\); \(x = \dfrac{2000}{49} \approx 40.8\) m par girti hai; zyada se zyada height \(\dfrac{500}{49} \approx 10.2\) m

blocks.prompt:
3 A camera drone follows \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 6\cos t\,\hat{i} + 6\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.8t\,\hat{k}\), \(t \ge 0\) (metres, seconds). (i) Show that it always stays 6 m from the \(z\)-axis. (ii) Find its climb per turn. (iii) Find its position at \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) and after three full turns. (5 marks)
(Camera drone \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 6\cos t\,\hat{i} + 6\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.8t\,\hat{k}\), \(t \ge 0\) (metre, second) par chalta hai. (i) Dikhayein ke yeh hamesha \(z\)-axis se 6 m door rehta hai. (ii) Aik chakkar mein climb nikalein. (iii) \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par aur teen poore chakkar ke baad position nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: x aur y components ko saath dekhein (circle), phir z-component akela (yaksaan climb).

book_ref.quote: represents the steady ascent at 0.5 meters per second

steps: Aik chakkar: \(t\) \(2\pi\) barhta hai; climb \(= 1.6\pi \approx 5.03\) m
Yani \((6, 0, 4.8\pi) \approx (6, 0, 15.08)\), shuru ke point ke bilkul oopar

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(t - 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{6 - t}\,\hat{j} + \dfrac{1}{t^{2} - 9}\,\hat{k}\). Hence decide whether \(\mathbf{r}(2)\), \(\mathbf{r}(3)\) and \(\mathbf{r}(6)\) exist, and find those that do. (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(t - 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{6 - t}\,\hat{j} + \dfrac{1}{t^{2} - 9}\,\hat{k}\) ka domain nikalein. Phir batayein ke \(\mathbf{r}(2)\), \(\mathbf{r}(3)\), \(\mathbf{r}(6)\) maujood hain ya nahin, aur jo hain woh nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har component kahan defined hai, phir sirf woh t rakhein jo teeno ke liye theek hon.

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the domain and range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{9 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t + 2}\,\hat{j}\). (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{9 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t + 2}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har component ka domain, phir intersection; har component ki values sirf usi domain par, hissa hissa; range output points ka set hai.

book_ref.quote: Find the intersection of the domains of each component

steps: \(y\): pehle hisse mein \(y \le -1\); doosre hisse mein \(y \ge \dfrac{1}{5}\)
Range: points \(\left\langle\sqrt{9 - t^{2}}, \dfrac{1}{t + 2}\right\rangle\); yani \(\left(\sqrt{9 - \left(\dfrac{1}{y} - 2\right)^{2}},\ y\right)\), \(y \le -1\) ya \(y \ge \dfrac{1}{5}\)
Check: \(t = -3 \to (0, -1)\), \(t = 0 \to \left(3, \dfrac{1}{2}\right)\), \(t = 3 \to \left(0, \dfrac{1}{5}\right)\); \(y = -\dfrac{1}{2}\) ke liye \(t = -4\) chahiye, jo domain mein nahin
blocks.final_answer: Domain \([-3, -2) \cup (-2, 3]\); range: curve ke points \(\left(\sqrt{9 - t^{2}}, \dfrac{1}{t + 2}\right)\), \(x \in [0, 3]\), \(y \in (-\infty, -1] \cup \left[\dfrac{1}{5}, \infty\right)\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ghalti na karein: \(y = \dfrac{1}{t + 2}\) ki values tamam \(t\) par nahin, sirf domain wale \(t\) par dekhni hain. Is liye \(y\) 'zero ke siwa har number' nahin, balke \(y \le -1\) ya \(y \ge \dfrac{1}{5}\).

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the domain and range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (2t - 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{t}\,\hat{j}\), and describe the range as a curve. Is \((7, 2)\) in the range? Is \((7, -2)\)? (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (2t - 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{t}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain aur range nikalein aur range ko curve ke tor par bayan karein. Kya \((7, 2)\) range mein hai? \((7, -2)\)?)
blocks.explanation: Square root se domain, phir t khatam kar ke dekhein ke output points kis curve par hain.

book_ref.quote: Determine the domain of each component separately.

steps: Range: parabola \(x = 2y^{2} - 1\) ka ooper wala aadha (\(y \ge 0\)), \((-1, 0)\) se shuru
\((7, 2)\): \(t = 4\) se haan. \((7, -2)\): \(\sqrt{t}\) kabhi negative nahin: nahin

blocks.prompt:
7 Starting from \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \displaystyle\lim_{\Delta t \to 0} \dfrac{\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)}{\Delta t}\), show that \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = f_{1}'(t)\,\hat{i} + f_{2}'(t)\,\hat{j} + f_{3}'(t)\,\hat{k}\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = f_{1}(t)\,\hat{i} + f_{2}(t)\,\hat{j} + f_{3}(t)\,\hat{k}\). Verify it from the definition for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) at \(t = 1\). (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \displaystyle\lim_{\Delta t \to 0} \dfrac{\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)}{\Delta t}\) se shuru kar ke dikhayein ke \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = f_{1}'(t)\,\hat{i} + f_{2}'(t)\,\hat{j} + f_{3}'(t)\,\hat{k}\). Phir \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) ke liye \(t = 1\) par definition se tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Difference quotient ko component by component likhein; unit vectors constant hain, is liye limit har component par lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: If the limit exists, then \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) is computed by differentiating each component:

steps: \(\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)\) ko teen brackets mein likhein (har component ki tabdeeli)
\(\Delta t\) se taqseem: har bracket \(\dfrac{f_{n}(t + \Delta t) - f_{n}(t)}{\Delta t}\); \(\hat{i}, \hat{j}, \hat{k}\) constant
\(\Delta t \to 0\): har quotient \(f_{n}'(t)\) ban jata hai, is liye \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = f_{1}'\,\hat{i} + f_{2}'\,\hat{j} + f_{3}'\,\hat{k}\)
\(t = 1\) par: \(\dfrac{(1 + \Delta t)^{2} - 1}{\Delta t} = 2 + \Delta t\), \(\dfrac{(1 + \Delta t)^{3} - 1}{\Delta t} = 3 + 3\Delta t + (\Delta t)^{2}\)
Limit: \(\mathbf{r}'(1) = 2\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\); components wala tareeqa bhi yahi deta hai
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = f_{1}'(t)\,\hat{i} + f_{2}'(t)\,\hat{j} + f_{3}'(t)\,\hat{k}\); \(t^{2}\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) ke liye \(\mathbf{r}'(1) = 2\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\)

blocks.prompt:
8 Find \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) and \(\mathbf{r}'(0)\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\cos t\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{t}{1 + t^{2}}\,\hat{j} + \sqrt{2t + 1}\,\hat{k}\). (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\cos t\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{t}{1 + t^{2}}\,\hat{j} + \sqrt{2t + 1}\,\hat{k}\) ke liye \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) aur \(\mathbf{r}'(0)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har component ko munasib rule (product, quotient, chain) se differentiate karein, phir t = 0 rakhein.

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
9 Find \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sec 2t\,\hat{i} + \ln(\cos t)\,\hat{j} + \cos^{2}t\,\hat{k}\). (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sec 2t\,\hat{i} + \ln(\cos t)\,\hat{j} + \cos^{2}t\,\hat{k}\) ke liye \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har component ko chain rule se aam tor par differentiate karein, phir t = pi/6 rakhein.

book_ref.quote: first differentiate each component in general, then substitute

blocks.prompt:
10 A part on a sorting machine has position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 3\cos t\,\hat{j}\) (metres, seconds). At \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) find its velocity, acceleration, speed and direction of motion, and say whether it is speeding up or slowing down. (5 marks)
(Sorting machine par aik purze ki position \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 3\cos t\,\hat{j}\) (metre, second) hai. \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity, acceleration, speed, direction of motion nikalein aur batayein ke yeh tez ho raha hai ya aahista.)
blocks.explanation: Aam tor par aik dafa differentiate kar ke v, do dafa a; phir t rakhein; speed = |v|, direction = v/|v|, v . a ka sign batata hai tez ya aahista.

book_ref.quote: the derivative of the velocity vector with respect to time

blocks.prompt:
11 A drone inspects a chimney along \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 3t\,\hat{k}\) (metres, seconds). At \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) find (i) velocity (ii) acceleration (iii) speed (iv) direction of motion. Show that the acceleration points towards the chimney's axis (the \(z\)-axis) and that the speed is not changing. (5 marks)
(Drone chimney ka muayna \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 4\cos t\,\hat{i} + 4\sin t\,\hat{j} + 3t\,\hat{k}\) (metre, second) par karta hai. \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par (i) velocity (ii) acceleration (iii) speed (iv) direction of motion nikalein. Dikhayein ke acceleration chimney ke axis (\(z\)-axis) ki taraf hai aur speed nahin badal rahi.)
blocks.explanation: Component by component differentiate karein, phir t rakhein; a ko drone ki position se mila kar dekhein ke kidhar hai.

book_ref.quote: the direction only (the unit tangent vector)

steps: Position \((0, 4, 1.5\pi)\): \(-4\,\hat{j}\) wapas \(z\)-axis ki taraf; \(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = 0\), speed nahin badalti

blocks.prompt:
12 A particle moves on \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j}\). (i) Show that its path is the ellipse \(\dfrac{x^{2}}{9} + \dfrac{y^{2}}{4} = 1\). (ii) Show that \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -\mathbf{r}(t)\). (iii) Find where on the path the speed is greatest and least. (5 marks)
(Particle \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j}\) par chalta hai. (i) Dikhayein ke raasta ellipse \(\dfrac{x^{2}}{9} + \dfrac{y^{2}}{4} = 1\) hai. (ii) Dikhayein ke \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -\mathbf{r}(t)\). (iii) Raaste par speed kahan sab se zyada aur kahan sab se kam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Raaste ke liye cos^2 + sin^2 = 1; a ke liye do dafa differentiate; speed ka square sirf sin^2 t mein likhein.

book_ref.quote: is the acceleration of the particle, denoted by

steps: \(\mathbf{a} = -3\cos t\,\hat{i} - 2\sin t\,\hat{j} = -\mathbf{r}(t)\): acceleration hamesha origin ki taraf
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\mathbf{a} = -\mathbf{r}\); zyada speed \(3\), \((0, \pm 2)\) par; kam speed \(2\), \((\pm 3, 0)\) par

blocks.prompt:
13 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos 2t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin 2t\,\hat{j}\), show that (i) the speed is constant, (ii) \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -4\,\mathbf{r}(t)\), (iii) \(\mathbf{v} \perp \mathbf{a}\) at every \(t\), and (iv) \(|\mathbf{a}| = \dfrac{(\text{speed})^{2}}{\text{radius}}\). (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos 2t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin 2t\,\hat{j}\) ke liye dikhayein ke (i) speed constant hai, (ii) \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -4\,\mathbf{r}(t)\), (iii) har \(t\) par \(\mathbf{v} \perp \mathbf{a}\), (iv) \(|\mathbf{a}| = \dfrac{(\text{speed})^{2}}{\text{radius}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Chain rule se differentiate karein (har dafa 2 ka factor), phir sin^2 + cos^2 = 1 aur dot product.

blocks.prompt:
14 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\,\hat{i} + y(t)\,\hat{j} + z(t)\,\hat{k}\), show that \(\dfrac{d}{dt}|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = 2\,\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a}\). Use it to show that the particle on \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos 3t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin 3t\,\hat{j} + 5t\,\hat{k}\) moves with constant speed, and find that speed. (5 marks)
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\,\hat{i} + y(t)\,\hat{j} + z(t)\,\hat{k}\) ke liye dikhayein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dt}|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = 2\,\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a}\). Is se dikhayein ke \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos 3t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin 3t\,\hat{j} + 5t\,\hat{k}\) wala particle constant speed se chalta hai, aur woh speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: |v|^2 ko velocity components ke squares ka jama likhein aur chain rule se differentiate karein.
steps: \(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = 0\), is liye \(|\mathbf{v}|^{2}\) nahin badalta: speed constant
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\dfrac{d}{dt}|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = 2\,\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a}\); helix ke liye \(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = 0\), constant speed \(\sqrt{61}\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Speed ka square \(|\mathbf{v}|^{2}\) hai. Agar \(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = 0\) ho to is ka derivative zero hai, yani speed nahin badalti; acceleration sirf simt (direction) mor raha hai, jaise circle ya helix par.

blocks.prompt:
15 A ball moves with \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 12t\,\hat{i} + (19.6t - 4.9t^{2})\,\hat{j}\) (metres, seconds). Find (i) the time of flight (ii) the time and value of the greatest height (iii) the horizontal distance covered (iv) the velocity and speed when it lands. (5 marks)
(Ball \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 12t\,\hat{i} + (19.6t - 4.9t^{2})\,\hat{j}\) (metre, second) par chalti hai. (i) Hawa mein waqt (ii) sab se zyada height ka waqt aur qeemat (iii) horizontal faasla (iv) girte waqt velocity aur speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Girne ke liye y = 0; sab se ooncha point par vertical velocity zero; velocity r ka derivative hai.

book_ref.quote: represent the velocity vector of the particle, which is tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
16 A particle moves with \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t^{3} - 3t^{2})\,\hat{i} + (2t^{2} - 8t)\,\hat{j}\), \(t \ge 0\). (i) When is it at rest, and where? (ii) Find its speed at \(t = 1\) and \(t = 3\), and say whether it is speeding up or slowing down at each. (5 marks)
(Particle \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t^{3} - 3t^{2})\,\hat{i} + (2t^{2} - 8t)\,\hat{j}\), \(t \ge 0\), par chalta hai. (i) Yeh kab aur kahan ruka hua hai? (ii) \(t = 1\) aur \(t = 3\) par speed nikalein aur batayein ke tez ho raha hai ya aahista.)
blocks.explanation: Ruka hua yani v = 0 (dono components aik saath zero); tez ya aahista ke liye v . a ka sign.

book_ref.quote: how fast and which way it moves (tangent to the path)

blocks.final_answer: (i) \(t = 2\) par \((-4, -8)\) par ruka hua (ii) \(t = 1\): speed \(5\), aahista; \(t = 3\): speed \(\sqrt{97}\), tez

blocks.prompt:
17 A particle moves with \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\cos t\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\sin t\,\hat{j}\). (i) Show that its speed is \(\sqrt{2}\,e^{t}\). (ii) At \(t = 0\) find its velocity, acceleration and direction of motion, and say whether it is speeding up. (5 marks)
(Particle \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\cos t\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\sin t\,\hat{j}\) par chalta hai. (i) Dikhayein ke speed \(\sqrt{2}\,e^{t}\) hai. (ii) \(t = 0\) par velocity, acceleration aur direction of motion nikalein, aur batayein ke kya yeh tez ho raha hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har component par product rule; speed ke liye squares khol kar jama karein.

book_ref.quote: how fast and which way it moves (tangent to the path)

steps: \(\mathbf{v} = e^{t}(\cos t - \sin t)\,\hat{i} + e^{t}(\sin t + \cos t)\,\hat{j}\)
blocks.final_answer: Speed \(\sqrt{2}\,e^{t}\); \(t = 0\) par: \(\mathbf{v} = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{a} = 2\,\hat{j}\), \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(\hat{i} + \hat{j})\); tez ho raha hai

blocks.prompt:
18 A robot's gripper moves with \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 2t\,\hat{j} + \ln t\,\hat{k}\), \(t > 0\). At \(t = 1\) find its velocity, acceleration, speed and direction of motion, and say whether it is speeding up or slowing down. (5 marks)
(Robot ka gripper \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 2t\,\hat{j} + \ln t\,\hat{k}\), \(t > 0\), par chalta hai. \(t = 1\) par velocity, acceleration, speed aur direction of motion nikalein, aur batayein ke tez ho raha hai ya aahista.)
blocks.explanation: Har component ko do dafa differentiate karein, t = 1 rakhein, phir |v|, v/|v| aur v . a ka sign.

book_ref.quote: how fast it moves, without direction
